title: King Chulalongkorn Memorial Building
scope: The present royal Thai memorial pavilion exterior in Utanede, including the raised stone terrace, white and gold columned hall, layered Thai gables and gilded royal spire.
limitations: The exterior proportions follow the photographs and the documented overall height. Gilded relief is simplified and exact rear trim details are estimated. Only the pavilion and its stone terrace are modeled.
